notes: Static evidence from the exact pinned archives plus active authored recipe replacements. Recipe IDs that were explicitly removed by KubeJS are excluded. Production evidence selects real construction rather than reset, color removal, block deconstruction or optional absent-mod recipes. This file is not a survival playthrough. Native registry/provenance tests validate the runtime separately.

methods.crafting: Real recipe completion in the player crafting grid or supported ME/Molecular Assembler crafting, including native crafting serializers.
methods.ae2_inscriber: Real finish of the AE2 Inscriber recipe; item pickup or inventory is insufficient.
methods.mekanism_infusing: Real finish of a Mekanism Metallurgic Infuser recipe; item pickup or inventory is insufficient.
methods.starter_supply: Small ordinary consumable/material exception; never grants production proof.

fresh_items: Construct a new empty/default ItemStack. Never copy a crafted barrel/backpack inventory, storage UUID, stored energy, mana, upgrades, affixes or arbitrary components into rewards.
